description: Hoechst Pakistan Limited was incorporated in 1967, began manufacturing pharmaceuticals and speciality chemicals in 1972 and went public in 1977. Formerly Sanofi aventis Pakistan, it took its present name in 2023 after Sanofi Foreign Participant BV sold its entire shareholding to a consortium including IGI Investments and affiliates of the Arshad Ali Gohar Group. It manufactures, sells and trades pharmaceutical and related products.
